items.title: Joseph Ralph Robinson Interview, 1960-10-12
items.q: La Roca was the name of them boys. ... Them boys used to play back there and make records, you know.

ctx.x: Can you remember what he played?
No, no. I can't remember. La Roca, I think. La Roca. Let me see La Roca. I believe it's La Roca.
There was another piano player, De La Roque. De La Roque or something.
